title: Flat K-flat scalar model preservation and computation
statement: Let X be a scheme and j_i:Y_i→X a finite pairwise disjoint clopen cover. Use the actual small pro-etale module sheaves, scalar extension presentations p_a and their normalized successive compositor n, exact restrictions r_i and r_D,i, canonical cochain computation morphisms c_a(P), normalized identity units, and scalar comparison interfaces of [def-pur-clopen-derived-scalar-comparison-data]. For any global and component presentations p,q with normalizations n,m, and any comparison family d, the predicates computed and extended hold. Explicitly, for every a:R→S and flat-term K-flat R-complex P, c_a(P) and c_(a_i)(r_i P) are isomorphisms. The complex E_a P has flat terms and is K-flat over S, and r_i(E_a P) has flat terms and is K-flat over S_i. No flatness of a is assumed.

proof.text:
apply K-flat ringed-topos pullback with the identity underlying topos to a.
This gives flatness and K-flatness over S. Apply clopen flatness and K-flatness
detection to R and S to restrict both input and output models. The normalized
scalar counits are invertible on those models; the remaining factors of computation
are canonical isomorphisms, and their composites are invertible. No flatness of a
is used, and zero sheaves and empty components satisfy the same argument.

lean.statement:
theorem clopen_scalar_model_properties
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (I : Type w) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{t})
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i)]
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (j i)) (Set.range (j k))))
    (hc : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (j i))
    (p : Presentations.{t, u} X)
    (n : Normalization.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (C := X.ProEt) (J := topology X) (hD := derived.{t, u} X) @p)
    (q : ∀ i, Presentations.{t, u} (Y i))
    (m : ∀ i, Normalization.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max (u + 1) (t + 2)}
      (C := (Y i).ProEt) (J := topology (Y i)) (hD := derived.{t, u} (Y i))
      (fun {R S} a ↦ q i (R := R) (S := S) a))
    (d : ∀ i, Comparison.{t, u} (j i) @p
      (fun {R S} a ↦ q i (R := R) (S := S) a)) :
    ∀ i, (d i).computed ∧ (d i).extended
